title: Truck Horn Loud
blurb: An air horn from something very large, blasted at a level that assumes you are sitting in a cab rather than wearing headphones. Truck horns run low and loud on purpose, because the stopping distance of a heavy vehicle means the driver needs you to move now rather than shortly. That urgency is why the sound cuts through in edits: it reads as immediate danger with no setup required. It is also a well-established way to ruin somebody's afternoon mid-call. Turn the volume down before the first press, then decide whether you want it back up.
origin: A generic recording of a heavy-goods-vehicle air horn.
